It sounds incredibly frustrating to feel like your concerns—some of them genuinely about safety, like the shelf or the dog getting hit—aren't being heard or taken seriously. That kind of repeated disconnect can leave you feeling dismissed and alone, even in your own home.

One thing that sometimes helps is naming the specific pattern rather than the individual moments: "When I share something important and get a phrase like that, I feel unheard, and it worries me because some of these are real safety issues." It can also help to pick one or two things that matter most and focus there, rather than everything at once. If these conversations keep going nowhere, a counselor—individually or as a couple—can offer tools for communicating so you both feel respected. You deserve to feel like your voice matters.
